questions.question: The average of five consecutive odd numbers is 15. What is the smallest of these five numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For consecutive odd numbers, the average is exactly the middle term.

Since there are 5 numbers, the 3rd (middle) number is 15.

Consecutive odd numbers always decrease by 2 as we move left.

Smallest number (1st number) = 15 − 2 × 2 = 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 5 consecutive odd numbers = 15

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all terms ÷ Total number of terms

questions.question: Jaya invested Rs. 14800 at 8.5% per annum on simple interest. The interest earned after 6 months is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate for 6 months (half year) = 8.5% ÷ 2 = 4.25%

Simple Interest = 4.25% of 14800

Simple Interest = 4.25 × 148 = 629

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 629.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 14800

Rate (R) = 8.5% per annum

Time (T) = 6 months = 6 ÷ 12 = 1/2 year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Principal
 Rs. 14800

 
 Simple Interest
 Rs. 629

 
• 
 R = 8.5% p.a.
 T = 6 months

 I = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (14800 × 8.5 × 1/2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (148 × 8.5) ÷ 2

⇒ SI = 74 × 8.5

⇒ SI = 629

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 629.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

Simple interest is calculated on the original principal for the entire given period. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Compound Interest (CI)

Compound interest is calculated on the principal as well as the accumulated interest of previous periods. Formula: Amount = P(1 + R/100)T.

Rule of 72

A quick trick to estimate the number of years required to double the invested money at a given annual fixed interest rate. Time ≈ 72 ÷ Rate.
</p

questions.question: Each interior angle of a regular octagon is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Each exterior angle of a regular polygon = 360° ÷ n

For a regular octagon, number of sides (n) = 8

Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 8 = 45°

Each interior angle = 180° − Exterior angle = 180° − 45° = 135°

**∴ The correct answer is 135°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Shape = Regular Octagon

Number of sides (n) = 8

Formula used: Each interior angle of a regular polygon = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dd113a4c777831ddacc1319d89a4fc0d93b8dc1f28422114321a6a09911c323.png] 

Calculations:

⇒ Sum of all interior angles = (n − 2) × 180°

⇒ Sum = (8 − 2) × 180°

⇒ Sum = 6 × 180° = 1080°

⇒ Each interior angle = Total Sum ÷ Number of sides

⇒ Each interior angle = 1080° ÷ 8

⇒ Each interior angle = 135°

**∴ The correct answer is 135°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of all exterior angles of any convex polygon is always 360°.

Number of Diagonals

The number of diagonals in a polygon with n sides is given by the formula: [n × (n − 3)] ÷ 2.

Regular Polygon Property

In a regular polygon, all interior angles are equal, and all side lengths are equal.

Interior and Exterior Angle Relation

At each vertex of a polygon, the interior angle and the exterior angle are supplementary, meaning their sum is 180°.</p

questions.question: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 4 and 60 respectively. These numbers could be
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

Required Product = 4 × 60 = 240

Check options for product 240: 12 × 20 = 240

Verify HCF(12, 20) = 4 and LCM(12, 20) = 60.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 and 20.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF of two numbers = 4

LCM of two numbers = 60

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35d93ab08bbca468705f662c87eb2017f5fc9c25ebeacc1ec5832489e3ad2b12.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the numbers be 4x and 4y, where x and y are co-prime.

⇒ LCM = HCF × x × y

⇒ 60 = 4 × x × y

⇒ xy = 60 ÷ 4 = 15

⇒ Possible co-prime pairs for (x, y) are (1, 15) and (3, 5).

⇒ If (x, y) = (1, 15), numbers are (4 × 1, 4 × 15) = (4, 60).

⇒ If (x, y) = (3, 5), numbers are (4 × 3, 4 × 5) = (12, 20).

⇒ Comparing with options, the pair (12, 20) is present.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 and 20.**

**__Additional Information__**

Product Property

For any two positive integers a and b, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).

HCF and LCM Relationship

The HCF of any group of numbers is always a factor of their LCM. If HCF does not divide LCM, such a pair of numbers cannot exist.

Co-prime Factors

If the HCF of two numbers is H, the numbers can be expressed as Hx and Hy, where x and y are co-prime (HCF of x and y is 1).</p

questions.question: After allowing a discount of 10% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for Rs. 450. Had the discount not been given, the profit would have been 25%. What is the 50% of the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Marked Price (MP) = Selling Price ÷ (1 − Discount%) = 450 ÷ 0.9 = Rs. 500.

If no discount is given, SP = MP = Rs. 500, which yields a 25% profit.

Ratio of CP : MP = 100 : (100 + Profit%) = 100 : 125 = 4 : 5.

Since 5 units = Rs. 500, then 4 units (CP) = Rs. 400.

50% of CP = 400 × 0.5 = Rs. 200.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 450

Discount = 10%

Profit (without discount) = 25%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a5ac90d0004d5454d77b6208786c79ec4f611f3e58d668f8480b42517c7ea53.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Marked Price (MP) = SP × [100 / (100 − Discount%)]

⇒ MP = 450 × (100 / 90)

⇒ MP = 450 × (10/9) = Rs. 500

⇒ If no discount is given, New SP = MP = Rs. 500

⇒ In this case, Profit = 25%

⇒ Cost Price (CP) = New SP × [100 / (100 + Profit%)]

⇒ CP = 500 × (100 / 125)

⇒ CP = 500 × (4/5) = Rs. 400

⇒ Required value = 50% of CP = 400 × (50 / 100)

⇒ Required value = Rs. 200

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

CP, MP, and Profit Relationship

The relationship between Cost Price and Marked Price is given by: MP/CP = (100 + Profit%) / (100 − Discount%).

Markup Percentage

Markup % = [(MP − CP) / CP] × 100. It represents the percentage by which the cost price is increased to set the marked price.

Profit when Discount is 0

When no discount is offered, the Selling Price equals the Marked Price. Therefore, Profit = MP − CP.</p

questions.question: While listing N consecutive even numbers for determining their average, the last number, by mistake, got replaced by the next odd number and thereby the average turned out to be more than the desired value by 0.0125. What is the value of N?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The next odd number after any even number L is L + 1.

Total Increase in Sum = (L + 1) − L = 1.

Increase in Average = (Total Increase in Sum) ÷ (Number of Terms N).

0.0125 = 1 ÷ N

N = 1 ÷ 0.0125 = 80.

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of consecutive even numbers = N

Error: Last even number replaced by next odd number

Increase in average = 0.0125

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e60de71f8d76c81c51127486d8316eaf7d0f398414175c6dfe74df0cbb3a51f6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the N consecutive even numbers be E₁, E₂, ..., EN.

⇒ Let their original sum be S.

⇒ Original Average = S ÷ N.

⇒ The last number EN is replaced by (EN + 1).

⇒ New Sum = S − EN + (EN + 1) = S + 1.

⇒ New Average = (S + 1) ÷ N = (S ÷ N) + (1 ÷ N).

⇒ Change in average = (New Average) − (Original Average) = 1 ÷ N.

⇒ Given that this change is 0.0125.

⇒ 1 ÷ N = 0.0125

⇒ N = 1 ÷ 0.0125

⇒ N = 10000 ÷ 125 = 80.

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effect of Observation Change on Average

If a single observation in a set of N terms is increased by 'k', the new average increases by exactly k ÷ N compared to the old average.

Consecutive Even Numbers

Consecutive even numbers form an Arithmetic Progression (AP) with a common difference of 2. The average of any N consecutive numbers in an AP is (First term + Last term) ÷ 2.

Decimal to Fraction Conversion

Shortcut for N: Since 0.125 = 1/8, then 0.0125 = 1/80. Therefore, 1 ÷ N = 1 ÷ 80 implies N = 80.</p

questions.question: Arun can do a piece of work in 10 days and Bimla can do it in 20 days. If they both work for 2 days, how much work is left?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work (LCM of 10 and 20) = 20 units.

Efficiency: Arun = 20 ÷ 10 = 2 units/day; Bimla = 20 ÷ 20 = 1 unit/day.

Combined Efficiency = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day.

Work done in 2 days = 3 × 2 = 6 units.

Work left = (20 − 6) ÷ 20 = 14 ÷ 20 = 0.7.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Arun = 10 days

Time taken by Bimla = 20 days

Duration of work together = 2 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

Remaining Work = 1 − (Work Done)

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 Arun
 10
 20
 2
 
 

 Bimla
 20
 1
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of Arun and Bimla = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day

⇒ Work completed in 2 days = 3 × 2 = 6 units

⇒ Total work to be done = 20 units

⇒ Remaining units of work = 20 − 6 = 14 units

⇒ Fraction of work left = 14 ÷ 20 = 0.7

**∴ The correct answer is 0.7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Rule

If a person can complete a work in n days, then the work done in 1 day is 1/n.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the ratio of the work done by each person (Efficiency × Time).

Pipes and Cisterns

The same logic applies; inlet pipes have positive efficiency while outlet pipes have negative efficiency.</p

questions.question: In a company, there are only two types of employees, workers, and officers. 35% of the employees are officers and the average monthly salary of an officer is ₹39,000 more than the combined average monthly salary of all employees. What is the difference between the average monthly salaries of an officer and a worker?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Officers : Workers = 35% : 65% = 7 : 13.

Deviation of Officer's salary from the combined average = +₹39,000.

Applying the net deviation rule: Sum of deviations = 0.

7 × (+39,000) + 13 × (Worker's deviation) = 0.

Worker's deviation = −(7 × 39,000) ÷ 13 = −₹21,000.

Total difference = Officer's surplus + Worker's deficit = 39,000 + 21,000 = ₹60,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹60,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of Officers = 35%

Percentage of Workers = 100% − 35% = 65%

AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ − AvgTₒₜₐₗ = ₹39,000

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average: n₁(A₁ − Aₐvg) = n₂(Aₐvg − A₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b23348bb97cdfe1aec5cfe9df57aa3fcdf32bd14c9c4f6d7e68f19b91bb7b8ac.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Ratio of Officers (nO) to Workers (nW) = 35 : 65 = 7 : 13

⇒ Let AvgTₒₜₐₗ be A, then AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ = A + 39,000

⇒ Let AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ be AW

⇒ 7 × (AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ − A) = 13 × (A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ)

⇒ 7 × (39,000) = 13 × (A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ)

⇒ A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ = (7 × 39,000) ÷ 13

⇒ A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ = 7 × 3,000 = 21,000

⇒ Difference = AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ

⇒ Difference = (AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ − A) + (A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ)

⇒ Difference = 39,000 + 21,000 = 60,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹60,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule for Averages

The ratio of the quantities of two groups is the inverse ratio of the differences of their individual averages from the combined average: n₁/n₂ = (A₂ − Aₐvg) / (Aₐvg − A₁).

Net Deviation Method

In any distribution, the sum of the products of the frequency and the deviation of each value from the mean is always zero: ∑ fᵢ(xᵢ − x̄) = 0.

Weighted Average Formula

The combined average of two groups is given by Aₐvg = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) / (n₁ + n₂), where n represents the number of items and A represents the average.

questions.question: In a ΔABC, if ∠A = 90°, AC = 5 cm, BC = 9 cm, and in ΔPQR, ∠P = 90°, PR = 3 cm, QR = 8 cm, then:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Compare corresponding parts of right-angled ΔABC and ΔPQR.

In ΔABC: Hypotenuse BC = 9 cm and Side AC = 5 cm.

In ΔPQR: Hypotenuse QR = 8 cm and Side PR = 3 cm.

Congruence (RHS) requires Hypotenuse 1 = Hypotenuse 2 and Side 1 = Side 2.

Since 9 ≠ 8 and 5 ≠ 3, the triangles cannot be congruent.

**∴ The correct answer is ΔABC ≇ ΔPQR.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ΔABC: ∠A = 90°, AC = 5 cm, BC = 9 cm (Hypotenuse)

ΔPQR: ∠P = 90°, PR = 3 cm, QR = 8 cm (Hypotenuse)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89b0ac819db213682b3bf2149aa361401a41fe3ddac32e59e458778a5e09dee8.png] 

**Formula Used:**

RHS (Right angle-Hypotenuse-Side) Congruence Rule: Two right-angled triangles are congruent if the hypotenuse and one side of one triangle are equal to the hypotenuse and the corresponding side of the other triangle.

⇒ In ΔABC, using Pythagoras theorem: AB² = BC² − AC²

⇒ AB² = 9² − 5² = 81 − 25 = 56
⇒ AB = √56 cm ≈ 7.48 cm

⇒ In ΔPQR, using Pythagoras theorem: PQ² = QR² − PR²

⇒ PQ² = 8² − 3² = 64 − 9 = 55
⇒ PQ = √55 cm ≈ 7.41 cm

⇒ Comparing the dimensions of ΔABC and ΔPQR:

⇒ Hypotenuse: BC (9 cm) ≠ QR (8 cm)
⇒ Side 1: AC (5 cm) ≠ PR (3 cm)
⇒ Side 2: AB (√56 cm) ≠ PQ (√55 cm)

⇒ Since none of the corresponding sides are equal, the triangles are not congruent.

**∴ The correct answer is ΔABC ≇ ΔPQR.**

**__Additional Information__**

RHS Congruence Rule

If in two right-angled triangles, the hypotenuse and one side of one triangle are equal to the hypotenuse and one side of the other triangle, then the two triangles are congruent.

SSS Congruence Rule

Two triangles are congruent if all three sides of one triangle are equal to the corresponding three sides of the other triangle.

Congruence vs. Equality

Congruent triangles (≅) have the exact same shape and size (identical sides and angles), whereas equal triangles (=) usually refers to triangles having equal area even if shapes differ.</p

questions.question: Two students appeared for an examination. One of them secured 9 marks more than the other and his marks were 56 % of the sum of their marks. The marks obtained by them are-
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total marks of both students be 100%.

One student scored 56%, so the other student scored (100% − 56%) = 44%.

Difference in percentage = 56% − 44% = 12%.

According to the question, this 12% difference is equal to 9 marks.

12% = 9 marks ⇒ 1% = 0.75 marks.

Marks obtained = 56 × 0.75 = 42 and 44 × 0.75 = 33.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 and 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Difference in marks = 9. Student 1 marks = 56% of total.

**Formula:** Value = Percentage × Total Sum

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a4188a9473d2942a0a7638237dc20da85a294d6dbf790daf01bc0e495a504f0.png] 

⇒ Let the marks of the two students be x and (x − 9).

⇒ Sum of their marks = x + (x − 9) = 2x − 9.

⇒ According to the condition: x = 56% × (2x − 9)

⇒ x = (56 / 100) × (2x − 9)

⇒ 100x = 112x − 504

⇒ 112x − 100x = 504

⇒ 12x = 504

⇒ x = 504 ÷ 12 = 42 marks.

⇒ Second student marks = 42 − 9 = 33 marks.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 and 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Ratio Conversion

Calculating results using ratios is often faster. Here, the ratio of marks is 56 : 44 which simplifies to 14 : 11. The difference of 3 units corresponds to the 9 marks given.

Complementary Percentages

If one part is x%, the other part of the whole is always (100 − x)%. This is a fundamental concept in data interpretation and percentage problems.

Base Value in Percentages

Always identify the base on which the percentage is calculated. In this problem, the base is the sum of marks of both students.</p

questions.question: Which of the following is referred to as additive identify for whole numbers?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The additive identity is a number that, when added to any other number, does not change the value of that number.

Logic: a + 0 = a for any whole number 'a'.

By definition, adding 0 results in the original value, making it the identity element for addition.

**∴ The correct answer is zero.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The set of whole numbers W = {0, 1, 2, 3, ...}.

**Definition:** In any number system, an element 'e' is called the additive identity if for every element 'a' in that system, the condition a + e = a is satisfied.

⇒ Let 'a' be an arbitrary whole number.

⇒ a + e = a

⇒ e = a − a

⇒ e = 0

⇒ Since 0 is a member of the set of whole numbers, it satisfies the criteria.

⇒ Test: 5 + 0 = 5, 10 + 0 = 10, 0 + 0 = 0.

**∴ The correct answer is zero.**

**__Additional Information__**

Multiplicative Identity

The number 1 is called the multiplicative identity for whole numbers because any number multiplied by 1 remains unchanged (a × 1 = a).

Additive Inverse

For any integer 'a', the additive inverse is '−a' because their sum equals the additive identity (a + (−a) = 0). Note that whole numbers (except 0) do not have additive inverses within the set of whole numbers.

Closure Property of Addition

The sum of any two whole numbers is always a whole number (e.g., 2 + 3 = 5, where 5 is a whole number).</p

questions.question:
In the given figure; if radius of the circle is 21 cm and ∠POQ is 120°, then area of segment PRQ in (cm)² is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/919984ab78ed19d8c1a98120f639f7de865a06746577884e91165c0f5ab2ee4b.png]
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Area of minor segment = Area of Sector − Area of Triangle

Area = [(πθ/360) − (sin θ)/2] × r²

Area = [(22/7 × 120/360) − (sin 120°)/2] × 21²

Area = [22/21 − √3/4] × 441 = 462 − 441√3/4

Factoring out 21/4: Area = (21/4) × (88 − 21√3)

**∴ The correct answer is 21/4(88 − 21√3) cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 21 cm

Central Angle (θ) = 120°

**Formula Used:**

Area of Segment = (θ/360°) × πr² − (1/2)r² sin θ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63cca7bccf6fc950aaffe31e5c892cfa63fab2a56ebab2062802627490ee48a3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of sector POQR = (120/360) × (22/7) × 21 × 21

⇒ Area of sector = (1/3) × 22 × 3 × 21 = 462 cm²

⇒ Area of ΔPOQ = (1/2) × r² × sin 120°

⇒ sin 120° = sin(180° − 60°) = sin 60° = √3/2

⇒ Area of ΔPOQ = (1/2) × 441 × (√3/2) = 441√3 / 4 cm²

⇒ Area of segment PRQ = 462 − 441√3 / 4

⇒ Area of segment = (1848 − 441√3) / 4

⇒ Area of segment = (21 × 88 − 21 × 21√3) / 4

⇒ Area of segment = 21/4 × (88 − 21√3) cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 21/4(88 − 21√3) cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Area of Sector

The area of a sector with radius r and central angle θ (in degrees) is given by (θ/360) × πr².

Area of Triangle in a Circle

The area of a triangle formed by two radii and a chord is (1/2)r² sin θ, where θ is the angle between the radii.

Length of an Arc

The length of an arc subtending an angle θ at the center is L = (θ/360) × 2πr.

Major vs Minor Segment

Area of major segment = Total area of circle − Area of minor segment.</p

questions.question: In the set of first 100 multiples of 5, P is the average of the multiples on the odd places and Q is the average of the multiples on the even places. By what number, the value of Q is more than P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Each even-placed multiple is exactly 5 more than its preceding odd-placed multiple.

Multiples: (5, 10), (15, 20), (25, 30), ... (495, 500).

Difference between every pair (Even − Odd) = 5.

Therefore, Average of Even (Q) − Average of Odd (P) = Constant difference = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** First 100 multiples of 5: {5, 10, 15, 20, ..., 500}

**Formula Used:** Average of an Arithmetic Progression (AP) = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c19d951d10e21df646f40157dc7fbdd3bc5e7be6e07b333fe33200539cdc96ad.png] 

⇒ Set P (Odd places): 1st, 3rd, ..., 99th multiples

⇒ P = {5, 15, 25, ..., 495}

⇒ Average P = (5 + 495) ÷ 2 = 500 ÷ 2 = 250

⇒ Set Q (Even places): 2nd, 4th, ..., 100th multiples

⇒ Q = {10, 20, 30, ..., 500}

⇒ Average Q = (10 + 500) ÷ 2 = 510 ÷ 2 = 255

⇒ Difference = Q − P = 255 − 250 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of Arithmetic Progression

For any sequence in AP, the average is always the middle term or the mean of the first and last terms: (a + l) ÷ 2.

Consecutive Terms Difference

If every term of set B is 'k' more than the corresponding term of set A, then Average(B) − Average(A) = k.

Sum of First n Multiples

Sum of first n multiples of 'x' = x × [n(n+1) ÷ 2]. The average is x × (n+1) ÷ 2.</p

Since CP 6 units = ₹300, then 1 unit = ₹50

Marked Price (MP) = 7 units = 7 × ₹50 = ₹350

questions.question: A started a work and left working after 9 days now B finished the remaining work in 24 days. Had A left the work after working for 13 days then B would have finished the remaining work in next 18 days. Then find in how many days A and B together can complete the work
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Work done by A in (13 − 9) = 4 days is finished by B in (24 − 18) = 6 days.

Efficiency Ratio (A : B) = 6 : 4 = 3 : 2.

Total Work = (A × 9 days) + (B × 24 days) = (3 × 9) + (2 × 24) = 27 + 48 = 75 units.

Combined Efficiency of A + B = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day.

Time taken by A and B together = 75 ÷ 5 = 15 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: A works for 9 days, then B works for 24 days.

Case 2: A works for 13 days, then B works for 18 days.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let efficiency of A be 'a' and B be 'b'.

⇒ Total Work (W) = 9a + 24b = 13a + 18b

⇒ 13a − 9a = 24b − 18b

⇒ 4a = 6b

⇒ a/b = 6/4 = 3/2

⇒ Total Work = 9(3) + 24(2) = 27 + 48 = 75 units

⇒ Time taken by A alone = 75 ÷ 3 = 25 days

⇒ Time taken by B alone = 75 ÷ 2 = 37.5 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a work. If the ratio of time is x:y, the ratio of efficiency is y:x.

Combined Work Formula

Work and Wages

questions.question: If the radius of a right circular cone is 33.33% of the height then what could be the value for radius and height (in cm) respectively if the volume of the Cone is 27π?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Radius (r) to Height (h) = 33.33% = 1 : 3.

Let r = x and h = 3x.

Volume of Cone = (1/3) × π × x² × 3x = πx³.

Given: πx³ = 27π ⇒ x³ = 27 ⇒ x = 3.

Radius = 3 cm, Height = 3 × 3 = 9 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 cm and 9 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume (V) = 27π cm³

Radius (r) = 33.33% of Height (h)

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a Right Circular Cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc0c284ce7770a1748453abc8bc7a1b038ed42236122c43ae7735408755d90b5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ r = 33.33/100 × h ⇒ r = (1/3)h

⇒ h = 3r

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × π × r² × (3r)

⇒ 27π = (1/3) × π × r² × 3r

⇒ 27π = πr³

⇒ r³ = 27

⇒ r = √³27 = 3 cm

⇒ h = 3 × 3 = 9 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 3 cm and 9 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cone

The formula for CSA of a cone is πrl, where l is the slant height.

Slant Height Formula

The slant height (l) of a cone is given by l = √(r² + h²).

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cone

The TSA of a cone is given by the sum of CSA and base area: TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

Volume Relation

The volume of a cone is exactly 1/3rd of the volume of a cylinder with the same radius and height (πr²h).</p

questions.question: The third proportional of 0.024 and 0.12 is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Third proportional of a and b is given by c = b² ÷ a.

Given: a = 0.024, b = 0.12.

Third proportional = (0.12 × 0.12) ÷ 0.024

Third proportional = 0.0144 ÷ 0.024 = 0.6.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.600.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** First number (a) = 0.024, Second number (b) = 0.12

**Formula Used:** If a, b, and c are in continued proportion, then a : b = b : c, where c is the third proportional.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da83011e0d135d58fab4875602088cee5af49ac67164ebe664d8be78c9ef5e4e.png] 

⇒ Let the third proportional be x.

⇒ 0.024 : 0.12 = 0.12 : x

⇒ 0.024 ÷ 0.12 = 0.12 ÷ x

⇒ x = (0.12 × 0.12) ÷ 0.024

⇒ x = 0.0144 ÷ 0.024

⇒ x = 14.4 ÷ 24

⇒ x = 0.6

**∴ The correct answer is 0.600.**

**__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

Fourth Proportional

In the proportion a : b :: c : d, d is called the fourth proportional and is given by d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Continued Proportion

Three non-zero quantities a, b, c are said to be in continued proportion if a/b = b/c.</p

questions.question: How many kgs of first quality rice costing Rs. 21/kg should a shopkeeper mix with 12.5 kgs of ordinary rice costing Rs. 12 per kg so that he makes a profit of 25% on selling the mixture at Rs. 20/kg?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price (CP) of the mixture = 20 ÷ 1.25 = ₹16/kg.

Apply Alligation ratio: (Mixture CP − Ordinary CP) : (Quality CP − Mixture CP).

Ratio of First Quality : Ordinary = (16 − 12) : (21 − 16) = 4 : 5.

Given, 5 units = 12.5 kg ⇒ 1 unit = 2.5 kg.

First quality rice required = 4 units × 2.5 = 10 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 kg.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP of first quality rice (CP₁) = ₹21/kg

CP of ordinary rice (CP₂) = ₹12/kg

Quantity of ordinary rice (Q₂) = 12.5 kg

Selling Price of mixture (SPₘ) = ₹20/kg

Profit percentage = 25%

**Formula Used:**

CP = SP ÷ (1 + Profit%)

Rule of Alligation: Q₁/Q₂ = (CPₘ − CP₂) / (CP₁ − CPₘ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5943100ae93fcf5f78515e9243c12a015fe6b03987dc73a7d57e2c2201cafe31.png] 

⇒ Cost Price of mixture (CPₘ) = 20 ÷ (1 + 25/100) = 20 ÷ 1.25

⇒ CPₘ = 20 × (100 / 125) = 20 × (4 / 5) = ₹16/kg

⇒ Ratio (First : Ordinary) = (16 − 12) : (21 − 16) = 4 : 5

⇒ Let quantity of first quality rice be Q₁

⇒ Q₁ / 12.5 = 4 / 5

⇒ Q₁ = (4 × 12.5) ÷ 5 = 50 ÷ 5

⇒ Q₁ = 10 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 10 kg.**

**__Additional Information__**

Rule of Alligation

It states that if two ingredients are mixed, the ratio of the quantity of the cheaper to the quantity of the dearer is (CP of dearer − Mean Price) ÷ (Mean Price − CP of cheaper).

Profit and Cost Price Relation

To find the cost price when a profit is made, use CP = (Selling Price × 100) ÷ (100 + Profit%). Always use CP for alligation calculations.

Weighted Average Method

The mean price can also be calculated as Cₘ = (n₁c₁ + n₂c₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is quantity and c is cost.

questions.question: Aman started a business investing 70000 rs. Rakhi joined him after six months with an amount of 105000 rs. and Sagar joined them with 1.4 lakhs rs. after another six months. The amount of profit earned should be distributed in what ratio among Aman, Rakhi and Sagar respectively, 3 years after Aman started the business?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Capitals: 70,000 : 1,05,000 : 1,40,000 = 2 : 3 : 4

Ratio of Time: 36 months : 30 months : 24 months = 6 : 5 : 4

Profit Ratio = (Capital × Time) Ratio

Profit Ratio = (2 × 6) : (3 × 5) : (4 × 4) = 12 : 15 : 16

**∴ The correct answer is 12 : 15 : 16.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Aman investment = ₹70,000 | Rakhi investment = ₹1,05,000 | Sagar investment = ₹1,40,000

Aman time = 3 years = 36 months

Rakhi time = 36 − 6 = 30 months

Sagar time = 30 − 6 = 24 months

**Formula:** Profit Ratio = (Investment₁ × Time₁) : (Investment₂ × Time₂) : (Investment₃ × Time₃)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f8d7d2d8f6f92419bca66202ba519bc2d30c19e6030e9a2750e5cf10d64f89e.png] 

⇒ Profit Ratio = (70000 × 36) : (105000 × 30) : (140000 × 24)

⇒ Simplifying by 1000: (70 × 36) : (105 × 30) : (140 × 24)

⇒ Dividing by 35: (2 × 36) : (3 × 30) : (4 × 24)

⇒ Dividing by 6: (2 × 6) : (3 × 5) : (4 × 4)

⇒ Profit Ratio = 12 : 15 : 16

**∴ The correct answer is 12 : 15 : 16.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Partnership Rule

Profit is always distributed in the ratio of the product of Capital and Time Period (P = C × T).

Working vs. Sleeping Partner

A working partner manages the business and may receive a salary or commission before the remaining profit is shared among all partners.

Variable Investment

If a partner changes their investment amount during the year, total profit share is calculated as Σ(Capitalₙ × Timeₙ).

questions.question: In 100m race, A runs at 6 kmph. If A gives B a start of 4m and still beats him by 12 seconds, what is the speed of B?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Time taken by A = (Distance ÷ Speed) = 100 ÷ (6 × 5/18) = 60 seconds.

B takes 12 seconds more to cover 4m less distance.

Time taken by B = 60 + 12 = 72 seconds.

Distance covered by B = 100 − 4 = 96 m.

Speed of B = (96 ÷ 72) × (18/5) = 4.8 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.8 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Race Distance = 100 m

Speed of A = 6 km/hr

Start given to B = 4 m

Time lag (A beats B) = 12 seconds

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f1383c5dca232540c71d0a8a32890000e18e47ca5bb2f32718739138fe7bd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of A in m/s = 6 × (5/18) = 5/3 m/s

⇒ Time taken by A to finish 100m = 100 ÷ (5/3) = 60 seconds

⇒ Since A beats B by 12 seconds, B takes (60 + 12) = 72 seconds

⇒ Distance covered by B = Total Distance − Start = 100 − 4 = 96 m

⇒ Speed of B = Distance ÷ Time = 96 ÷ 72 = 4/3 m/s

⇒ Speed of B in km/hr = (4/3) × (18/5)

⇒ Speed of B = 24/5 = 4.8 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 4.8 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Race Terminology

'A gives B a start of x meters' means B starts x meters ahead of A. 'A beats B by t seconds' means A finishes the race t seconds before B.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Dead Heat

A dead heat occurs when all participants finish the race at the exact same time, meaning the time taken by each is equal.</p

questions.question: During a storm, a tree broke at a point 5 m above the ground in such a way that the top of the tree touched the ground 12 m away from where it originally stood. What was the height of the tree before it broke?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Recognize the Pythagorean triplet: (5, 12, 13).

Stump height (Perpendicular) = 5 m, Distance (Base) = 12 m.

Broken part (Hypotenuse) = 13 m.

Total tree height = Stump height + Broken part = 5 + 13 = 18 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Height of the stump (p) = 5 m

Distance from base to the top on ground (b) = 12 m

Formula: h² = p² + b²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b72815cb43aea8a068ddec83a296931c4b01d75597d74f453cb1061d9a734be6.png] 

⇒ Let the length of the broken part be AC.

⇒ AC² = (5)² + (12)²

⇒ AC² = 25 + 144 = 169

⇒ AC = √169 = 13 m

⇒ Total height of the tree = Height of the stump + Length of the broken part

⇒ Total height = 5 m + 13 m = 18 m

**∴ The correct answer is 18 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagoras Theorem

In any right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².

Common Pythagorean Triples

Standard integer sets that satisfy the theorem include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (7, 24, 25). Multiples of these also form triples.

Right-Angled Triangle Properties

The hypotenuse is always the longest side, and it is the side opposite to the 90° angle.</p
